summary: Authorities have closed at least 14 Tesco stores after a security alert. Police blocked car parks and closed stores in Lancashire, Suffolk, Dyfed Powys, Fife, Leicestershire, Humberside, West Mercia, West Yorkshire, Nottinghamshire, Strathclyde and London. An unnamed Barrhead worker said the manager kept a nearby shop open; Hertfordshire police said enquiries are criminal and no injuries were reported.
